title: Increasing Popcount
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

You are given positive integers $L$ and $R$ satisfying $L\le R$.

A sequence of positive integers $A=(A_L,A_{L+1},\ldots,A_R)$ of length $R-L+1$ satisfying the following condition is called a **good integer sequence**:

- For every pair of integers $(i,j)$ satisfying $L\le i < j\le R$, if $A_i = A_j$, then $\operatorname{popcount}(i)<\operatorname{popcount}(j)$.

Find the minimum value of $\max(A_L,A_{L+1},\ldots,A_R)$ over all good integer sequences $A=(A_L,A_{L+1},\ldots,A_R)$.

You are given $T$ test cases; solve each of them.

What is $\operatorname{popcount}$? For a non-negative integer $x$, $\operatorname{popcount}(x)$ is the number of $1$'s when $x$ is written in binary. More precisely, when a non-negative integer $x$ satisfies $\displaystyle x=\sum _ {i=0} ^ \infty b _ i2 ^ i\ (b _ i\in\lbrace0,1\rbrace)$, $\displaystyle\operatorname{popcount}(x)=\sum _ {i=0} ^ \infty b _ i$. For example, $13$ written in binary is `1101`, so $\operatorname{popcount}(13)=3$.

## Constraints

- $1\le T\le 10^4$
- $1\le L \le R\le 10^{18}$
- All input values are integers.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
T
\text{case}_1
\text{case}_2
\vdots
\text{case}_T
```

Each test case is given in the following format.

```
L R
```

## Output

Output $T$ lines.

The $i$-th line $(1\le i\le T)$ should contain the answer for the $i$-th test case $\text{case}_i$.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

给定满足 $L\le R$ 的正整数 $L$ 和 $R$。

长度为 $R-L+1$ 的正整数序列 $A=(A_L,A_{L+1},\ldots,A_R)$，如果满足以下条件，则称为**良好整数序列**：

- 对于所有满足 $L\le i < j\le R$ 的整数对 $(i,j)$，若 $A_i = A_j$，则必须有 $\operatorname{popcount}(i)<\operatorname{popcount}(j)$。

请在所有良好整数序列 $A=(A_L,A_{L+1},\ldots,A_R)$ 中，求 $\max(A_L,A_{L+1},\ldots,A_R)$ 的最小值。

给定 $T$ 组测试用例，请分别求解。

什么是 $\operatorname{popcount}$？对于非负整数 $x$，$\operatorname{popcount}(x)$ 表示 $x$ 的二进制表示中 $1$ 的个数。更准确地说，若非负整数 $x$ 满足 $\displaystyle x=\sum _ {i=0} ^ \infty b _ i2 ^ i\ (b _ i\in\lbrace0,1\rbrace)$，则 $\displaystyle\operatorname{popcount}(x)=\sum _ {i=0} ^ \infty b _ i$。例如，$13$ 的二进制表示为 `1101`，因此 $\operatorname{popcount}(13)=3$。

## 约束条件

- $1\le T\le 10^4$
- $1\le L \le R\le 10^{18}$
- 输入的所有数值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
T
\text{case}_1
\text{case}_2
\vdots
\text{case}_T
```

每组测试用例按以下格式给出。

```
L R
```

## 输出格式

输出 $T$ 行。

第 $i$ 行 $(1\le i\le T)$ 应包含第 $i$ 组测试用例 $\text{case}_i$ 的答案。

samples.note:
Consider the first test case.

$(A_3,A_4,A_5,A_6)=(1,2,2,3)$ is a good integer sequence, and $\max(A_3,A_4,A_5,A_6)=3$.

There is no good integer sequence with $\max(A_3,A_4,A_5,A_6) < 3$, so output $3$ on the first line.
